durationMs.reveal: No entrance reveal. Tiles are visible and in place at first paint; only a state change (for example loading to ready) may fade content in over the transition duration.

hover.trigger: pointer enters a link tile or an enabled control
hover.effect: A link tile's border turns evergreen and its trailing arrow shifts 2px. Buttons change surface tone. Static tiles do not react.
hover.reducedMotion: No arrow travel. Keep the evergreen border and surface change as an instant state; focus ring unchanged.

press.effect: Darken the surface tone immediately. No scale, bounce, or tile lift.
press.reducedMotion: Same color change, applied instantly. No translation or scale.

reveal.trigger: a tile leaves the loading state
reveal.effect: Skeleton rows are replaced by content with a short opacity fade; the tile keeps its size so the grid does not shift.
reveal.reducedMotion: Swap content without fading. The polite live message still announces the result.

image.effect: Photos stay still inside their tiles. No zoom, parallax, or crossfade.
image.reducedMotion: Images are already static. No zoom, translation, or stagger.

menu.trigger: menu, portal sidebar, or dropdown open or close action
menu.effect: Fade the sheet or menu surface as one group; links are operable immediately. Focus moves in on open and returns to the trigger on close.
menu.reducedMotion: Show and hide instantly. Focus still moves and returns; scroll lock unchanged.

global.contentBeforeEnhancement: Visible, usable, and in reading order.
global.colorTransition: Border and surface color may transition over the feedback duration; reduced motion applies them instantly. Loading skeletons do not shimmer when motion is reduced.
